description:
A security incident has occurred: an access token named 'Jenkins-Staging' was leaked. Your task is to revoke this specific token to prevent unauthorized access. 

There is another active token named 'Jenkins-Production' which MUST remain active to avoid breaking the build pipeline.

A file at `/home/ga/leaked_token_info.txt` contains the Token ID of the compromised credential for your reference.

**Steps:**
1. Log in to Artifactory (admin/password) if not already logged in.
2. Navigate to the Administration module.
3. Locate the Access Tokens management section (under User Management or Identity & Access).
4. Find the token with description 'Jenkins-Staging' (verify the Token ID matches the text file).
5. Revoke ONLY the 'Jenkins-Staging' token.
6. Ensure 'Jenkins-Production' remains active.
